scope: XAUUSD M1 BUY US 08:00-17:00 America/New_York; E_DISPLAY_EPISODE_REACTION_RANK_US_BUY_V1

scientific_interpretation.DEV_role: model development and freeze only; in-sample evidence is not validation
scientific_interpretation.decision_basis: The preregistered DEV association, ordering and QA evidence is sufficiently strong and internally coherent to justify one already-declared, strictly frozen historical replication diagnostic.

non_gating_robustness_note.description: An independent descriptive split of DEV into three contiguous session-count blocks was checked only for gross temporal concentration; it was not used to tune or replace any preregistered metric.

authorization.M1_input_rule: Use only the 12 hash-verified Dukascopy BID M1 files 2025-08 through 2026-07 declared in the frozen data-input manifest.
authorization.missing_M1_rule: Retain and report the two known partial sessions and all 482 missing M1 opens; skip missing opens as unavailable bars exactly as preregistered. No post-outcome session deletion or alternate treatment is permitted.
allowed_operations: load the immutable frozen DEV model without refit
apply the frozen DEV preprocessing, coefficients, score distribution, rank mapping and quartile cutpoints
compute and report the preregistered replication diagnostics
freeze and hash the complete replication evidence package
forbidden_operations: refit or alter the frozen DEV model
change features, transformations, family vocabulary, reaction definition, horizon, ambiguity handling, rank mapping, quartile cutpoints, bootstrap or gates
load DEV labels for refitting or model selection
drop the two partial replication sessions after outcome access
call the rank a calibrated probability or universal E strength

replication_support_rule_frozen_before_o.purpose: Prevents subjective rescue after replication is read. Passing can authorize only a later prospective-confirmation planning gate, never production.
checks: at least 90 completed NY sessions represented
session-cluster 95% CI lower bound for AUC minus 0.5 greater than 0
fixed DEV quartile success rates satisfy Q1 <= Q2 <= Q3 <= Q4
fixed DEV Q4 minus Q1 greater than 0
session-cluster 95% CI lower bound for Q4 minus Q1 greater than 0
fixed DEV Q4 minus Q1 positive in all three contiguous complete-session blocks
feature exclusion rate no greater than 2%
no frozen method or data-definition component changed
replication_support_rule_frozen_before_o.failure_policy: No retrospective tuning or alternate candidate rescue; return to a newly preregistered research cycle if further work is desired.

next_checkpoint.required_evidence: Immutable replication labels, input manifest, label QA, frozen-model load/no-refit QA, replication report, environment, hashes, workflow run and artifact digest.
